source: Written 2026-10-14 from Scryfall oracle text verified that day and this deck's notes (deck-verify run 37654666265). Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named. Printed power/toughness is only stated for tokens, whose size the card text gives.

scenes.head: Beorn the Fierce — Bear Den
scenes.sub: Every combat, one of your creatures becomes a Bear. Bears hit harder and draw you cards.

scenes.head: Other Bears get +2/+2
scenes.sub: Beorn has trample, and every other Bear you control gets +2/+2.
scenes.say: Beorn has trample, and every other Bear you control gets +2/+2.

scenes.head: Beginning of combat, on your turn
scenes.sub: Beorn puts a trample counter on up to one creature you control. It becomes a Bear in addition to its other types.

scenes.head: The [[Hulking Raptor|Raptor]] is a Bear now
scenes.sub: It gets Beorn's +2/+2 on top of the trample counter. The text has no "until end of turn": it stays a Bear.
scenes.say: The Raptor is a Bear now, with Beorn's +2/+2 and a trample counter. Nothing says until end of turn, so it stays a Bear.

scenes.head: Three Bears: draw two
scenes.sub: Beorn, [[Ayula, Queen Among Bears|Ayula]] and the Raptor are three Bears, so Beorn draws you two cards. Every one of your turns.

scenes.head: "Up to one" target
scenes.sub: You can convert nothing at all and still draw two, as long as you already control three Bears.
scenes.say: Up to one target: you can convert nothing and still draw two, if you already control three Bears.

scenes.head: Make Bears. Grow them. Trample over.
scenes.sub: Three clips show how, and the last one shows how it wins.

scenes.head: Eight natural Bears
scenes.sub: These are Bears before Beorn touches them, so his draw-two turns on sooner.

cards.name: Beorn, Reluctant Host // Till and Tend

scenes.head: Bear tokens
scenes.sub: [[The Earth King]] makes a 4/4 Bear when it enters. [[Dancing from Dark to Dawn]] makes a 2/2 Bear whenever a land you control enters.
scenes.say: Bear tokens. [[The Earth King]] makes a four-four Bear when it enters. [[Dancing from Dark to Dawn]] makes a two-two Bear whenever a land you control enters.

scenes.head: Next to Beorn: 6/6 and 4/4
scenes.sub: Beorn's +2/+2 counts tokens too, so every land drop is a 4/4 Bear.
scenes.say: Next to Beorn, they're six-sixes and four-fours. So every land drop is a four-four Bear.

scenes.head: Three cost cutters
scenes.sub: [[Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma|Goreclaw]]: creature spells with power 4 or more cost {2} less. [[Radagast of Rhosgobel|Radagast]]: your first creature spell each turn costs {2} less. [[The Earth Crystal]]: green spells cost {1} less.

scenes.head: Beorn for {G}{G}
scenes.sub: With [[Radagast of Rhosgobel|Radagast]] and [[The Earth Crystal|the Crystal]] out, his {3}{G}{G} cost drops by three. Radagast also lets that first creature be cast as though it had flash.
scenes.say: Beorn for two green. [[Radagast of Rhosgobel|Radagast]] and [[The Earth Crystal|the Crystal]] cut three from his five-mana cost, and Radagast lets him be cast as though he had flash.

scenes.head: Cast him at their end step
scenes.sub: Flash Beorn in after the table has had its chance to wipe the board. On your turn he can convert and attack.

scenes.head: Why [[Swiftfoot Boots]]?
scenes.sub: Hexproof only stops your opponents' targeting, so Beorn can still convert the creature wearing them. Shroud would stop that.
scenes.say: Why Swiftfoot Boots? They give hexproof, which only stops your opponents' targeting, so Beorn can still convert the creature wearing them. Shroud would stop that.

scenes.head: Ayula, Queen Among Bears
scenes.sub: Whenever another Bear you control enters, choose one: put two +1/+1 counters on target Bear, or a Bear you control fights a creature you don't control.

scenes.head: Land, Bear, trigger
scenes.sub: Play a Forest. [[Dancing from Dark to Dawn]] makes a 2/2 Bear, and that Bear entering triggers Ayula.
scenes.say: Play a Forest. [[Dancing from Dark to Dawn]] makes a two-two Bear, and that Bear entering triggers Ayula.

scenes.head: Fight: a land drop is removal
scenes.sub: Next to Beorn the new token is a 4/4. It fights their 3/3 and survives the 3 damage.
scenes.say: Choose fight. Next to Beorn, the new token is a four-four. It fights their three-three, and survives the three damage.

scenes.head: …and their creature is gone.
scenes.say: And their creature is gone.

scenes.head: Or grow, doubled by [[The Earth Crystal]]
scenes.sub: On the next trigger, choose two +1/+1 counters. The Crystal puts twice that many on a creature you control, so Ayula's two become four.
scenes.say: Or grow. On the next trigger, choose two +1/+1 counters. [[The Earth Crystal]] doubles them, so Ayula's two become four.

scenes.head: Every +1/+1 counter, doubled
scenes.sub: [[Hulk, Brutal Brawler|Hulk]]'s attack gives each other creature two. [[Beorn's Hospitality]] gives two per land. [[Managorger Hydra]] gets two per spell cast. [[Dancing from Dark to Dawn|Dancing]] gives twice a creature spell's mana value.
scenes.say: Every +1/+1 counter is doubled. [[Hulk, Brutal Brawler|Hulk]]'s attack gives each other creature two. [[Beorn's Hospitality|Hospitality]] gives two per land. [[Managorger Hydra]] gets two per spell. [[Dancing from Dark to Dawn|Dancing]] gives twice a creature spell's mana value.

scenes.head: Converting isn't entering
scenes.sub: Beorn makes a creature a Bear without it entering, so Ayula doesn't trigger. But it is now a Bear you control, so it can be the one that fights.

scenes.head: The Earth King
scenes.sub: When it enters, make a 4/4 Bear. Whenever creatures you control with power 4 or more attack, fetch up to that many basic lands, tapped.
scenes.say: The Earth King. When it enters, make a four-four Bear. Whenever creatures with power four or more attack, fetch up to that many basic lands, tapped.

scenes.head: Next to Beorn, every Bear token has power 4+
scenes.sub: Attack with three: the 6/6 and two 4/4s. The Earth King fetches three basic lands.
scenes.say: Next to Beorn, every Bear token has power four or more. Attack with three, and The Earth King fetches three basic lands.

scenes.head: Three Forests, three more Bears
scenes.sub: They enter tapped mid-combat. [[Dancing from Dark to Dawn|Dancing]] makes a 2/2 Bear for each one, and every one of those Bears triggers Ayula.
scenes.say: Three Forests enter tapped, mid-combat. Dancing makes a two-two Bear for each one, and every one of those Bears triggers Ayula.

scenes.head: Pump the attackers
scenes.sub: [[Beorn's Hospitality]] puts a +1/+1 counter on a creature for each land, [[Necklace of Girion]] one for each Forest. Aim them at your attackers before damage.

scenes.head: [[Hexhaven Invigorator]]: damage into land
scenes.sub: Whenever it's dealt damage, search for up to that many land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped. Once Beorn makes it a Bear, Ayula's next trigger can make it fight.
scenes.say: [[Hexhaven Invigorator]]. Whenever it's dealt damage, fetch up to that many lands, tapped. Once Beorn makes it a Bear, Ayula's next trigger can make it fight.

scenes.head: Kogla, the Titan Ape
scenes.sub: When it enters, it fights up to one creature you don't control. Whenever it attacks, destroy an artifact or enchantment the defending player controls.

scenes.head: Kogla re-buys The Earth King
scenes.sub: {1}{G}: return a Human you control to hand, and Kogla gains indestructible this turn. The Earth King is a Human: recast him for another 4/4 Bear.
scenes.say: For one and green, Kogla returns a Human you control to hand and gains indestructible this turn. The Earth King is a Human: recast him for another four-four Bear.

scenes.head: Trample on everything
scenes.sub: Beorn hands out a trample counter every combat. [[Surrak and Goreclaw]], [[Garruk's Uprising]] and [[Ghalta the Unstoppable]] give the whole team trample.

scenes.head: Overwhelming Stampede
scenes.sub: Until end of turn, your creatures gain trample and get +X/+X, where X is your greatest power. If that's the 6/6 Bear token, every 4/4 Bear becomes a 10/10.
scenes.say: [[Overwhelming Stampede]]: your creatures gain trample and get plus X plus X, where X is your greatest power. With the six-six token, every four-four Bear becomes a ten-ten.

scenes.head: Unnatural Growth
scenes.sub: At the beginning of each combat, double the power and toughness of each creature you control until end of turn. Every 4/4 Bear swings as an 8/8.
scenes.say: Unnatural Growth. At the beginning of each combat, double the power and toughness of each creature you control until end of turn. Every four-four Bear swings as an eight-eight.

scenes.head: Get through blockers
scenes.sub: [[Rogue's Passage]]: {4}, tap: a creature can't be blocked this turn. [[Secret Tunnel]]: {4}, tap: two of your creatures that share a creature type can't be blocked. Bears all share Bear.
scenes.say: Get through blockers. [[Rogue's Passage]] makes one creature unblockable this turn. [[Secret Tunnel]] does it for two that share a creature type, and every Bear shares Bear.

scenes.head: Protect the swing
scenes.sub: [[Selfless Safewright]] has flash and convoke. Naming Bear gives your other Bears hexproof and indestructible this turn. [[Heroic Intervention]] covers every permanent you control.

scenes.head: Refuel: [[Last March of the Ents]]
scenes.sub: It can't be countered. Draw cards equal to your greatest toughness, then put any number of creature cards from your hand onto the battlefield.

scenes.head: Beorn the Fierce — Bear Den
scenes.sub: No Game Changers: it plays as a strong Bracket 2 or a light 3. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Beorn the Fierce, Bear Den. No Game Changers: it plays as a strong bracket two, or a light three. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
